plan.summary: This 4-week block starts a 12-week off-camp build for boxing with one focused full-body session each week. Week 1 establishes simple baselines with safe bodyweight performance tests so later weeks can progress cleanly. Weeks 2-4 build lower-body power, upper-body pushing and pulling strength endurance, trunk strength, and boxing-friendly conditioning without adding unnecessary soreness.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength, power, trunk stiffness, and work capacity with simple bodyweight movements done fast and clean.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the same movement patterns with harder variations, tighter density, and slightly higher power demands while keeping recovery manageable.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep the strength base, sharpen speed and repeat-power output, and stay fresh enough for high-quality boxing practice.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump as high as you can with a quick dip and a quiet landing. Rest fully between sets so every rep stays sharp.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if space is tight. Start from a still quarter squat and jump straight up.

exercises.name: Push-Up Strength Assessment
exercises.notes: Warm up with a few easy sets, then do one all-out clean set of standard push-ups. Stop when form breaks, keep the body straight, and log your best strict rep count to set your baseline.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then perform one hard top set of strict push-ups for maximum clean reps. Log the rep count so future progress can be compared against this baseline.

performanceTarget.prompt: Beat your Week 1 strict rep count over time without sacrificing position or range.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up Strength Assessment
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if floor push-ups are not yet clean. Use a stable surface and log the height used.
